chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas)
front_prompt: 1. How does the Gram Sabha hold the Gram Panchayat accountable?
back_answer: The Gram Sabha consists of all adult voters in the village. It meets regularly to examine development plans, review income and expenditure records of the Gram Panchayat, and ensure government funds benefit genuine local residents.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2 (Local Government in Rural Areas)
front_prompt: 1. Explain the three-tier structure of the Panchayati Raj system in India.
back_answer:
Point-wise Answer:
1. Base Tier (Gram Panchayat & Gram Sabha): Functions at the village level. All adult voters form the Gram Sabha (direct democracy) which elects the Gram Panchayat executive council headed by the Sarpanch.
2. Middle Tier (Panchayat Samiti): Functions at the block level, coordinating resources and plans across a group of neighboring Gram Panchayats.
3. Apex Tier (Zila Parishad): Functions at the district level, preparing overall district development plans and distributing state funds to blocks.
4. Self-Governance Goal: Enables rural citizens to solve local issues directly without depending on distant central offices.
5. Inclusivity: Mandated seat reservations ensure participation of women and marginalized sections.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Urban Local Body (ULB)' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Urban Local Body (ULB): The official institution of local self-government managing civic affairs in an urban area.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Municipal Corporation' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Municipal Corporation: The urban local body governing large metropolitan cities with high populations (Nagar Nigam).

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Municipality' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Municipality: The urban local body governing smaller towns and medium cities (Nagar Palika).

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Ward' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Ward: An administrative and electoral subdivision of a city or town.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Ward Councillor' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Ward Councillor: An elected representative chosen by voters of a specific ward to advocate for local needs.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Municipal Commissioner' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Municipal Commissioner: Senior civil administrative officer appointed by the State Government to execute city policies.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Mayor' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Mayor: The elected political head and presiding officer of a Municipal Corporation.

chapter_title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 (Local Government in Urban Areas)
front_prompt: Define 'Property Tax' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Property Tax: A local tax levied on property owners serving as a primary revenue source for municipal services.
